item.minecraft.netherite_axe.description:
Quickly breaks wooden blocks.
Can strip the bark from logs and remove oxidation or wax from copper blocks.
Deals slow but powerful damage.
item.minecraft.netherite_hoe.description:
Turns grass blocks or dirt into farmland for farming.
Quickly breaks plant blocks.
item.minecraft.netherite_pickaxe.descrip: Can mine stone and ore blocks.
item.minecraft.netherite_shovel.descript:
Quickly breaks dirt, sand, gravel, and snow.
Can turn grass blocks or dirt into dirt paths.
item.minecraft.netherite_spear.descripti:
Performs a jab attack that pierces through targets.
Can perform a charge attack where the damage increases with speed.
It has a long reach, but cannot hit targets that are too close.
item.minecraft.netherite_sword.descripti:
Can perform a sweeping attack that deals damage to multiple targets.
Quickly breaks cobwebs and breaks some plants slightly faster.
item.minecraft.netherite_upgrade_smithin: Used to upgrade Diamond gear to Netherite gear.
